title: Controlling · YTD / LYTD / Δ% por categoría
sql:
with ytd as (with nb as (select coalesce((select rc.display_name from room_categories rc where rc.company_id=n.company_id and rc.raw_value=n.room_category_raw limit 1), n.room_category_raw, '(Sin categoría)') cat, sum(n.price) prodacc, sum(case when n.bed_code_raw is null or n.bed_code_raw='' then rm.beds_per_room else 1 end) bn from nights n left join rooms rm on rm.company_id=n.company_id and rm.raw_value=n.room_code_raw where n.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and n.stay_date >= make_date($CY,1,1) and n.stay_date < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or n.stay_date <= current_date) group by 1),
  xb as (select coalesce((select rc.display_name from room_categories rc where rc.company_id=r.company_id and rc.raw_value=r.room_category_raw limit 1), r.room_category_raw, '(Sin categoría)') cat, sum(e.units*c.unit_price_gross) prodex from extras e join extras_catalog c on c.company_id=e.company_id and c.raw_value=e.raw_value join reservations r on r.company_id=e.company_id and r.reservation_uid=e.reservation_uid where e.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and not coalesce(c.is_passthrough,false) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) >= make_date($CY,1,1) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) <= current_date) group by 1),
  cap as (select coalesce(rc2.display_name,'(Sin categoría)') cat, sum(rm.beds_per_room) cap from room_capacity_calendar rcc join rooms rm on rm.id=rcc.room_id join room_categories rc2 on rc2.id=rm.category_id where rcc.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and rcc.status='open' and rcc.date >= make_date($CY,1,1) and rcc.date < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or rcc.date <= current_date) group by 1),
  j as (select c.cat, coalesce(nb.prodacc,0) prodacc, coalesce(nb.bn,0) bn, coalesce(xb.prodex,0) prodex, cap.cap from (select cat from nb union select cat from xb union select cat from cap) c left join nb on nb.cat=c.cat left join xb on xb.cat=c.cat left join cap on cap.cat=c.cat) select j.cat, (j.prodacc+j.prodex) prodtot, j.prodacc prodacc, j.prodex prodex, j.prodacc/nullif(j.bn,0) adb, j.bn bn, j.prodacc/nullif(j.cap,0) revpab from j),
  lytd as (with nb as (select coalesce((select rc.display_name from room_categories rc where rc.company_id=n.company_id and rc.raw_value=n.room_category_raw limit 1), n.room_category_raw, '(Sin categoría)') cat, sum(n.price) prodacc, sum(case when n.bed_code_raw is null or n.bed_code_raw='' then rm.beds_per_room else 1 end) bn from nights n left join rooms rm on rm.company_id=n.company_id and rm.raw_value=n.room_code_raw where n.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and n.stay_date >= make_date($LY,1,1) and n.stay_date < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or n.stay_date <= (current_date - interval '1 year')) group by 1),
  xb as (select coalesce((select rc.display_name from room_categories rc where rc.company_id=r.company_id and rc.raw_value=r.room_category_raw limit 1), r.room_category_raw, '(Sin categoría)') cat, sum(e.units*c.unit_price_gross) prodex from extras e join extras_catalog c on c.company_id=e.company_id and c.raw_value=e.raw_value join reservations r on r.company_id=e.company_id and r.reservation_uid=e.reservation_uid where e.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and not coalesce(c.is_passthrough,false) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) >= make_date($LY,1,1) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) <= (current_date - interval '1 year')) group by 1),
  cap as (select coalesce(rc2.display_name,'(Sin categoría)') cat, sum(rm.beds_per_room) cap from room_capacity_calendar rcc join rooms rm on rm.id=rcc.room_id join room_categories rc2 on rc2.id=rm.category_id where rcc.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and rcc.status='open' and rcc.date >= make_date($LY,1,1) and rcc.date < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or rcc.date <= (current_date - interval '1 year')) group by 1),
  j as (select c.cat, coalesce(nb.prodacc,0) prodacc, coalesce(nb.bn,0) bn, coalesce(xb.prodex,0) prodex, cap.cap from (select cat from nb union select cat from xb union select cat from cap) c left join nb on nb.cat=c.cat left join xb on xb.cat=c.cat left join cap on cap.cat=c.cat) select j.cat, (j.prodacc+j.prodex) prodtot, j.prodacc prodacc, j.prodex prodex, j.prodacc/nullif(j.bn,0) adb, j.bn bn, j.prodacc/nullif(j.cap,0) revpab from j)
select y.cat as section, p.pname as lbl, p.rc as rowcls, 7 as cs, p.period as _pord,
  case p.period when 1 then replace(to_char(round(y.prodtot), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' when 2 then replace(to_char(round(l.prodtot), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' else case when (y.prodtot-l.prodtot)/nullif(l.prodtot,0) is null then '' when (y.prodtot-l.prodtot)/nullif(l.prodtot,0) >= 0 then '▲ ' || replace(to_char((y.prodtot-l.prodtot)/nullif(l.prodtot,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' else '▼ ' || replace(to_char((y.prodtot-l.prodtot)/nullif(l.prodtot,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' end end as prodtot,
  case p.period when 1 then replace(to_char(round(y.prodacc), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' when 2 then replace(to_char(round(l.prodacc), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' else case when (y.prodacc-l.prodacc)/nullif(l.prodacc,0) is null then '' when (y.prodacc-l.prodacc)/nullif(l.prodacc,0) >= 0 then '▲ ' || replace(to_char((y.prodacc-l.prodacc)/nullif(l.prodacc,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' else '▼ ' || replace(to_char((y.prodacc-l.prodacc)/nullif(l.prodacc,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' end end as prodacc,
  case p.period when 1 then replace(to_char(round(y.prodex), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' when 2 then replace(to_char(round(l.prodex), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' else case when (y.prodex-l.prodex)/nullif(l.prodex,0) is null then '' when (y.prodex-l.prodex)/nullif(l.prodex,0) >= 0 then '▲ ' || replace(to_char((y.prodex-l.prodex)/nullif(l.prodex,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' else '▼ ' || replace(to_char((y.prodex-l.prodex)/nullif(l.prodex,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' end end as prodex,
  case p.period when 1 then replace(to_char(round(y.adb), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' when 2 then replace(to_char(round(l.adb), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' else case when (y.adb-l.adb)/nullif(l.adb,0) is null then '' when (y.adb-l.adb)/nullif(l.adb,0) >= 0 then '▲ ' || replace(to_char((y.adb-l.adb)/nullif(l.adb,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' else '▼ ' || replace(to_char((y.adb-l.adb)/nullif(l.adb,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' end end as adb,
  case p.period when 1 then replace(to_char(round(y.bn), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') when 2 then replace(to_char(round(l.bn), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') else case when (y.bn-l.bn)::numeric/nullif(l.bn,0) is null then '' when (y.bn-l.bn)::numeric/nullif(l.bn,0) >= 0 then '▲ ' || replace(to_char((y.bn-l.bn)::numeric/nullif(l.bn,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' else '▼ ' || replace(to_char((y.bn-l.bn)::numeric/nullif(l.bn,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' end end as bn,
  case p.period when 1 then replace(to_char(round(y.revpab), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' when 2 then replace(to_char(round(l.revpab), 'FM999G999G999'),',','.') || ' €' else case when (y.revpab-l.revpab)/nullif(l.revpab,0) is null then '' when (y.revpab-l.revpab)/nullif(l.revpab,0) >= 0 then '▲ ' || replace(to_char((y.revpab-l.revpab)/nullif(l.revpab,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' else '▼ ' || replace(to_char((y.revpab-l.revpab)/nullif(l.revpab,0)*100,'FM990D0'),'.',',') || '%' end end as revpab
from ytd y join lytd l on l.cat=y.cat cross join (values (1,'YTD','ytd'),(2,'LYTD','lytd'),(3,'Δ YoY','delta')) as p(period,pname,rc) order by y.cat, p.period
